title: Sales agent: semantic model for Dynamics 365 and Salesforce CRM data
summary: The briefing leaves automatic enablement unresolved even though Microsoft documents default Work IQ enablement and automatic semantic-model provisioning and consumption by Sales agent. The default field and rollout advice need to reflect that behaviour, with the documented environment exceptions.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Open questions: automatic enablement
claims.claim: The feature's default is unknown, including whether Sales agent uses the semantic model automatically when Work IQ is on.
claims.quote:
The semantic model is automatically provisioned and consumed by the following Copilot and agent experiences when they are set up over Dataverse data:
Sales Agent in Microsoft 365
claims.fix: Set defaultState to on. Replace the first Open questions bullet with: 'For Sales agent set up over Dataverse data, the semantic model is automatically provisioned and consumed. Work IQ is enabled by default for qualifying new environments from 30 September 2026 and qualifying existing environments from November 2026; the documented EU/EFTA, government-related and nonproduction exceptions still apply.' The already-cited semantic-model overview and Work IQ default-settings pages support this; retain the msdyn_viva Trial qualification.

claims.claim: Prepare is the appropriate action rating for this run.
claims.quote:
action: "prepare"
Learn states that Microsoft turns Work IQ on by default for new environments from 30 September 2026 and for existing environments from November 2026
claims.fix: Change action to act-now: on 17 November 2026, default enablement is current, the briefing rates risk medium, and its documented Work IQ and table-scope controls give administrators a decision to take now. Keep the accurate statement that MC1540293 itself requires no action.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout and After rollout
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks administrators to set or use appears in the controls table.
claims.quote:
Assign System Administrator, or Semantic Model plus Environment Maker, to the people who will tune the model
Review the model after schema changes: it regenerates every 12 hours, or an admin can regenerate manually.
claims.fix: The role-assignment instruction and manual-regeneration instruction have no corresponding controls-table rows. Do not add rows in this correction; change them to non-procedural checks: 'Confirm that the people tuning the model have the documented roles and that Dataverse meets the minimum version' and 'Review the model after schema changes; automatic regeneration runs every 12 hours.'
